about.header.title: Opportunity starts with belonging.
about.header.desc: We’re ODONG Foundation: a community-focused foundation helping young Indonesians grow through sports, esports, and leadership.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.desc: To empower Indonesian youth through sports programs that build character, develop leadership skills, and create opportunities for personal and community growth.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.desc: To be a leading force in youth development across Indonesia, creating a generation of confident, skilled, and compassionate leaders who positively impact their communities.
about.story.title: The game is just the beginning.
about.story.p1: We believe every young person deserves a place to discover what they can do. A shared love of sport or gaming can open that door—bringing people together who might never otherwise meet.
about.story.p2: Through Odong League, MyCampus League, and the Sport Leadership Academy, we turn that connection into opportunities to practice new skills, work as a team, and take responsibility.
about.story.p3: We work with schools, universities, communities, and partners to create spaces where young people can participate and contribute. The goal is growth that carries beyond a competition.

programs.header.title: Find your place. Build your potential.
programs.header.desc: Sports, esports, and leadership programs that connect young people with opportunities to learn and grow together.
programs.league.title: Odong League
programs.league.subtitle: Indonesia's Premier FIFA/EA Sports Esports League
programs.league.p1: Odong League is our flagship FIFA/EA Sports esports competition that brings together talented young gamers from across Indonesia. The league provides a platform for players to showcase their virtual football skills, learn from experienced esports coaches, and compete at a high level in competitive gaming.
programs.league.p2: With multiple participating esports clubs and teams, Odong League creates an environment where young gamers can develop not only their FIFA/EA Sports gaming skills but also important life skills such as strategic thinking, teamwork, discipline, and digital sportsmanship.
programs.campus.title: MyCampus League
programs.campus.subtitle: University Sports Competition
programs.campus.p1: MyCampus League is designed for university students who want to continue their athletic journey while pursuing higher education. This program recognizes that academic excellence and athletic achievement go hand in hand.
programs.campus.p2: The league fosters inter-university competition, building camaraderie among students from different institutions while promoting a healthy balance between studies and sports.
programs.academy.title: Sport Leadership Academy
programs.academy.subtitle: Developing Tomorrow's Leaders
programs.academy.p1: The Sport Leadership Academy is our comprehensive leadership development program that uses sports as a vehicle to teach essential leadership skills. Participants learn about communication, decision-making, team management, and ethical leadership.
programs.academy.p2: Through workshops, mentorship, and practical experience, academy graduates are prepared to become leaders in their communities, whether in sports, business, or social initiatives.
